def transform(grid):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    rs=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=9]
    cs=[c for c in range(W) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1 and grid[0][c]!=9]
    # compartments bounded by separators; reflect source motif in final compartment
    rb=[-1]+rs+[H]; cb=[-1]+cs+[W]
    r0,r1=rb[-2]+1,rb[-1]
    c0,c1=cb[-2]+1,cb[-1]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
      a,b=rb[ri]+1,rb[ri+1]
      for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
        x,y=cb[ci]+1,cb[ci+1]
        # same-sized compartments, reflect along separator boundaries
        for r in range(a,b):
          sr=r0+(r-a if ri%2==len(rb)-2 else (b-1-r))
          for c in range(x,y):
            sc=c0+(c-x if ci%2==len(cb)-2 else (y-1-c))
            out[r][c]=grid[sr][sc]
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Uniform non-background rows/columns form grid separators.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 9]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(W) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(H)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 9]
    rb, cb = [-1] + sep_rows + [H], [-1] + sep_cols + [W]
    # The occupied bottom-right cell supplies the motif, echoed in every tile.
    src_r, src_c = len(rb)-2, len(cb)-2
    sr0, sc0 = rb[src_r]+1, cb[src_c]+1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri in range(len(rb)-1):
        r0, r1 = rb[ri]+1, rb[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(cb)-1):
            c0, c1 = cb[ci]+1, cb[ci+1]
            # Match demo: the tile left of the motif is mirrored; tiles above it
            # are mirrored vertically, with the diagonal tile using both.
            flip_r = ri < src_r
            flip_c = ci < src_c
            for r in range(r0, r1):
                sr = sr0 + ((r1-1-r) if flip_r else (r-r0))
                for c in range(c0, c1):
                    sc = sc0 + ((c1-1-c) if flip_c else (c-c0))
                    out[r][c] = grid[sr][sc]
    return out
PY
